title: DISAGREEMENT AMONGST COUNTERFACTUAL EXPLANATIONS: HOW TRANSPARENCY CAN BE DECEPTIVE
reasoning: The paper investigates the ethical and moral hazards of the 'disagreement problem' in counterfactual explanations, specifically focusing on how this lack of consistency can be exploited for 'fairwashing' (hiding discriminatory or biased features). These ethical implications are a central component of the paper's motivation and analysis.
